## Combined frontier

The hypotheses do not compete equally. Stage 53 closes the finite and
conditional mathematics of H1 and separates three objects that the initial
wording conflated: the temporal vacuum amplitude, its inverse forward cost,
and the Perron optimizer of a declared bad subkernel. H1, H4, H5, and H8 still
combine into the primary normalized retained-state kernel target, but the
remaining H1 work is now entirely physical and uniform: construct the actual
nonlinear kernel and control its positive eigenweight. H3 is the leading
independent backup mechanism. H2 and H9 are downstream spectral bridges. H6,
H7, and H10 are representational control layers.

## First open physical implication

Uniformly over finite volume, cutoff, and every positive-mass retained
history, prove the normalized continuous good-channel comparison and
chart-complement bound, then add center, cut/orbit, and compositionally
complete integer-topology numerator bounds to a single strict weighted-kernel
ceiling.
